question: The Supreme Court of India consists of ________ judges and Chief Judges of India.
solution:
The correct answer is**__33__. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Supreme Court of India originally started with a **Chief Justice of India** and** 7 judges in 1950,** making a** total of 8 judges.** 
 
• 1978: Increased to **18 judges**.
 
• 2009: Further expanded to** 31 judges**.
 
• 2019: Reached the current strength of** 34 judges** (**1 Chief __Justice + 33 judges).**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Recommendation by the Collegium:** The Collegium, consisting of the Chief Justice of India __(CJI) and the four senior-most judges__,__ recommends names for appointment.
 
• For the **Chief Justice**, the senior-most judge is considered.
 
 
• **Presidential Appointment:** The President of India appoints the judges based on the Collegium's recommendation and the input from the Law Ministry.
 
• This process is guided by Articles** 124 and 217** of the Indian Constitution. 
 
• The current Chief Justice of India is** **Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai (B. R. Gavai) was appointed as the 52nd Chief Justice of India on 14th May 2025 and is due to retire on 23rd November 2025, upon attaining the age of 65 years.
